_README: A-09 (registered: preregistration.md:691). Cost bases: audited per-pass cost_usd from results/passes-manifest.json (per-pass extractor) on both sides of the matched-configuration comparison; the all-Flash pareto_v2 frontier (results/verifier-robustness/pareto/, modelled token-load-audit flex dollars) as the Flash-optimal yardstick. The two bases are not identically constructed (audit M-8); if the Pro passes were billed above flex rates the Pro side is over-costed, which makes the CLOSED verdict conservative. Comparability windows are operational choices declared in the limb blocks, not registered. Since 2026-10-12 (PI ruling D61 (4), executing D16 / WP7) cost_usd is the audited basis (D11), and the matched-configuration costs are NOT like-for-like: see cost_comparability_caveat and each modality's like_for_like_cost block.
verdict_basis: the Flash-optimal frontier (min6, min11) — the yardstick the registered scope limitation implies. The matched-configuration comparison measures the pure model effect at Pro's preferred corner (Flash never optimised there) and does not decide the gate.
cost_comparability_caveat: NOT LIKE-FOR-LIKE (PI ruling D61 (4); stated beside the cost figures before any re-signing). Text: the Flash comparator's audited $6.62 per pass (mean of 3) is standard-tier pricing that includes about 2.0 million thought tokens per pass ($0.60 without them), while Pro's $0.93 is the flex rate (its standard-tier price is $1.85) with no thinking delivered. Image: Pro's passes asked for flex but were served at standard (the cached path drops the service tier), $2.98 per pass with no thinking delivered; the Flash comparator's $4.49 is standard-tier pricing that includes about 1.2 million thought tokens per pass ($0.78 without them). On one tier (standard) with no thinking on either side, one Pro text pass costs 1.03 times the comparator's three-pass consensus (one pass against one, 3.1); for image, 1.27 (3.8). The audited gap therefore reflects Pro's undelivered thinking (Obs 509; reports/manipulation-check-2026-10-05.md § D) and the tier difference, not a cheaper model.

a08_statement: A-08 (the registered three-way transfer verdict, preregistration.md:693-699) is not computed: the registered Phase 2 varies four factors (M/E, H5, T, O) one at a time on Pro, and the existing Pro data cleanly vary exactly ONE of them — temperature, via the completed thinking x temperature 2x2 (S135 blind verification, HIGH-1; the earlier 'none cleanly' premise is superseded). M/E, H5, and O remain unvaried, so 'all factors within 0.03 of Flash-optimal' is unevaluable. Computing a three-way verdict from one factor would misrepresent the registered criterion; the honest disposition is not-computable-as-registered.
